sprints.title: Keep the workspace reliable
sprints.summary: Review updates to the software SalesDrone uses and verify sign-in on salesdrone.in. Settle who can manage administrator access before changing how it works.

sprints.title: Make everyday work easier to trust
sprints.summary: Plan more consistent lead searches, reduce contention when requests arrive together, and refresh the public guide. Administrator setup depends on the ownership decision in Sprint 1.

sprints.title: Lead Intelligence pilot
sprints.summary: Ask questions about leads you can access, see the evidence behind answers, and review suggested follow-ups before any action.

sprints.title: Separate workspaces for organizations
sprints.summary: Verify that one organization cannot see another’s data, then move the existing SalesDrone workspace with a tested way back. Prepare signup and workspace switching.

sprints.title: Invoicing pilot
sprints.summary: Try creating an invoice from a lead, issuing a PDF and recording a payment in a controlled trial. The pilot waits for workspace isolation and migration to pass.

sprints.title: Public signup decision
sprints.summary: Review migration, staged signup and invoicing pilot results before deciding whether to let new organizations sign up.
